## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `5bfde250b208529a3fc7347b030ae39f77d3a1e3`
Local-runs: none

Read in this act: card #12603 (body, triage `6207794844`, the claim `6209329731` as revised, the dev report `6210857581`), objectui#12593 and merged PR #12598 (the token's origin, `85e8961f28`), PR #12636's body, its 15-file list, the net diff against `main` at this head (merge base `63d00da3de`), and this head's check-runs. No earlier contract review exists on this PR; the head is reviewed whole. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The export.** `DIALOG_VIEWPORT_GUTTER = 'sm:w-[calc(100%-2rem)]'` in the new `packages/components/src/custom/dialog-viewport-gutter.ts`, one `export *` line added to the existing `custom/index.ts` barrel, which `packages/components/src/index.ts` already re-exports; `package.json` `exports` is untouched (`.` only), so the constant is reached through the one entry that exists. Minimal: one string constant, no prop, type member or second spelling. Named for what it is. Documented in the module's own header (the mechanism, the `100%`-not-`100vw` reasoning carried over verbatim from PR #12598, the `sm:`-only scope, and the pairing rule), and in the changeset, which ships as the package `CHANGELOG`. Docs line: `packages/components/README.md` enumerates no custom export (`MobileDialogContent`, `FullscreenEditor`, `NavigationOverlay`, `EmptyStateLink` are absent from it and from `content/docs`), and the last custom-barrel addition (`b434f5f47`, objectui#12270) documented its export at the consumer, not in that README. No docs page states a dialog width (`content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx` names `modalSize` levels only). So no README or guide line is owed on THIS PR; the changeset is the documentation of record for the export. Read as acceptable, flagged in ③.
- **Value identity.** PR #12598 defined `BOUNDED_SIZE_VIEWPORT_GUTTER = 'sm:w-[calc(100%-2rem)]'`; the new export is the same bytes, and the census pins it (`the gutter is the one class objectui#12593 measured`). `ModalForm`'s `lg` / `xl` rows change only the identifier inside the template, so the class string is byte-identical; the 12593 pin `modalViewportGutter-12593.test.tsx` is untouched by the diff.
- **The primitive.** `packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx` is not in the diff; nothing under `packages/components/src/ui/` is. The claim's stop condition holds.
- **Class lists.** At every site the token is appended beside the cap, either in a template literal or as an unconditional `cn()` argument. The only `w-` tokens it meets are `w-[95vw]` (RecordPickerDialog) and the primitive's `w-full`, both unprefixed, so `tailwind-merge` keeps them next to the `sm:` token with no conflict; `ImageLightbox`'s `max-w-[92vw] sm:max-w-4xl` is `max-w-`, a different group. The `full` size keeps `sm:max-w-[95vw] sm:w-full` and does not read the token. Emission: the PR body reports the console's own `@tailwindcss/postcss` step emitting `.sm\:w-\[calc\(100\%-2rem\)\]` under the `sm` media query, with the literal now spelled once in `dialog-viewport-gutter.ts`; the console's `@source` covers `packages/components/src`, and PR #12598 measured the same literal emitted from `plugin-form/src`. Not re-run here; consistent with the diff and the origin PR.
- **Census threshold.** Triage's ask was "every `DialogContent` with a `sm:max-w-` above `lg`". The census judges a breakpoint cap WIDE when it exceeds the breakpoint less 2rem (`sm:` above 608px, `lg:` above 992px), fails closed on a cap it cannot size, and skips a viewport-relative cap below 100. This is a sound reading: it catches every cap the literal reading would (`2xl` and up at `sm:` are all above 608px), drops only `sm:max-w-xl` (576px) and `sm:max-w-[560px]` / `[480px]` / `[425px]`, each of which keeps at least 32px a side in a 640px window and cannot show the defect, and it ADDS `md:` / `lg:` prefixed caps, arbitrary px / rem caps and unsizable caps, which the literal reading would miss. My own enumeration of every `(sm|md|lg|xl):max-w-` in non-test sources at this head finds the same nine centred sites and no other: every remaining wide cap is on a `SheetContent` (`FlowRunsPage`, `AuditLogPage`, `MetadataDetailDrawer`, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, `ResourceEditPage`, `ObjectChart`, `DrillDownDrawer`, `ObjectView`'s form panel), which the card excludes by design. Fails loudly: a NEW wide dialog fails `declared and found agree` until it is listed, and `every listed wide dialog reads the shared gutter` until it reads the export; a gutter literal of its own does not count (the `own` probe). Stated blind spots are honest: a className from a prop or `schema.className`, an inline style, a wrapper under another tag name, and an unprefixed cap (`max-w-5xl` with no breakpoint). I probed the last one: no `DialogContent` at this head carries an unprefixed wide cap.
- **`OWN_GUTTER`.** The one entry is `navigation-overlay.tsx`'s modal mode: `w-[calc(100vw-1rem)] max-w-none sm:max-w-[var(--ov-w,42rem)]`, caught by the fail-closed arm. It keeps 0.5rem a side at every width and is never edge to edge, so it is not the card's defect; it sits outside the enumeration and the claimed file surface, and converging it would be a visible width change on a component this card did not measure. Freezing it deletions-only, with a test that each entry is still a wide site without the shared gutter, is acceptable. Noted as a follow-up in the dev report with dedupe words; no card filed, which is right for polish.
- **RecordPickerDialog.** The card's table said it ran edge to edge; it did not, because `w-[95vw]` kept 2.5vw. Now the unconditional token applies under every rung. Between `sm` and its cap the dialog is `100% - 2rem` instead of `95vw`: identical at 640 (608 both), 6.4px wider at 768, 19.2px wider at 1024, never above its cap, never under 1rem a side, unchanged below `sm` and above cap plus 2rem. That is the one rule replacing a per-site margin, which is exactly what triage scoped; the gutter never shrinks below the family's floor. Not a regression.

All five are in the `fixed` group. The PR body's second line reads `Clause-②: yes`, and the claim was revised in place to `Clause-②: yes (widening)` with the same measurement. Correct.

- **app-shell suite narrowed to 126 files, declared.** On a `pull_request` run `scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs` selects every package a changed file sits in plus every transitive dependent as whole-directory filters, so `packages/app-shell/` is in CI's affected set in full across the 16 shards; the full battery on `main` runs within the hour either way. The dev's blind spot (a test rendering one of these dialogs without naming its module) is covered there. Not a gap in the record, provided the shards go green.

The three `skipped` runs are the coverage and dependabot lanes that never run on a pull request. This verdict is on the diff and the completed gates; the running ones remain CI's to conclude, and a red among them stands over this record.
